svg.title: StreetFix application architecture
svg.desc: Residents and staff share a React interface. Browser-side rules and Zod validation store reports, photos, supports and repair histories in IndexedDB. Leaflet requests OpenStreetMap tiles. Optional live AI sends a photo and resident text to a server endpoint and Google Gemini after consent. Vinext and Vite build the website and Cloudflare Worker. Reports are local to one browser; the demo role selector is not authentication.
svg.text: StreetFix / from resident report to public repair history
Implemented prototype architecture · browser data + optional server-side AI
Solid arrows: app and data flow
Both roles share one local snapshot.
Tailwind CSS 4 + Radix UI primitives · Lucide icons · Sonner notifications
Map / list, upload form, report detail sheet, staff queue and public updates
Staff updates: Reported → Planned → In progress → Fixed
Demo roles are not authentication. Data stays in this browser; storage failure falls back to session state.
Optional WebMCP tools read local reports or open their visible detail sheet in compatible browsers.
SERVER · APP DELIVERY AND OPTIONAL AI
Photo + resident text; no device coordinates
Return editable fields or a clear error
Timeout / provider failure → retry or manual
Response is checked before reaching the form
Humans submit reports and decide urgency.
This endpoint does not store city reports.
Real base map · fictional report fixtures
Map imagery is fetched separately from report data.
Fictional seed reports and repair histories
Node.js + npm → Vinext / Vite build → client assets + Worker · Wrangler preview / deployment
Checks: TypeScript + ESLint · node:test / tsx + fake-indexeddb · Playwright + Microsoft Edge
Starter scaffolding: Drizzle / D1, R2, ChatGPT auth helpers and connector bridge; unused by the report workflow.
Shared city pilot: add authenticated APIs, shared database / photo storage, staff permissions and AI request limits.
Presentation guide and editable Mermaid diagrams: architecture/README.md · Source of truth: implemented repository code
